page_data_script:
user = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Cafe User",
    {"handle": frappe.form_dict.handle},
    ["handle", "company", "designation", "bio", "introduction", "user"],
    as_dict=1,
)

if not user:
    raise frappe.PageDoesNotExistError

posts = frappe.db.get_all(
    "Cafe Post",
    fields=[
        "name",
        "title",
        "description",
        "cover_image",
        "reading_time",
        "slug",
        "creation",
    ],
    # limit=3,
    filters={
        "owner": user.user,
    },
    order_by="creation desc",
)


for post in posts:
    count = frappe.db.count("Cafe Post Comment", filters={"post": post["name"]})

    if count == 0:
        post["comments_count"] = None
    elif count == 1:
        post["comments_count"] = f"{count} comment"
    else:
        post["comments_count"] = f"{count} comments"

    if post.get("creation"):
        dt = frappe.utils.getdate(post["creation"])
        months = [
            "Jan",
            "Feb",
            "Mar",
            "Apr",
            "May",
            "Jun",
            "Jul",
            "Aug",
            "Sep",
            "Oct",
            "Nov",
            "Dec",
        ]
        post["formatted_date"] = f"{months[dt.month - 1]} {dt.day} {dt.year}"

    post.url = f"/cafe/posts/{post.slug}"

data.posts = posts

user_data = frappe.db.get_value(
    "User", frappe.form_dict.handle, ["full_name"], as_dict=1
)

breadcrumbs = [
    {"label": "Café", "url": "/cafe/explore"},
    {"label": user_data.full_name, "url": f"/cafe/profile/{user.handle}"},
    {"label": "Posts", "url": "#"},
]

data.page_data = {
    "is_logged_in": frappe.session.user != "Guest",
    "breadcrumbs": breadcrumbs,
}
